trips.subtitle: Active and completed trips
trips.gatesSubtitle: All gates must pass before Start trip.
trips.gateComplianceBlocked: Licence document or vehicle RWC is missing or expired. Ask your carrier to fix fleet docs, then refresh.
trips.safetyChecklistHint: Confirm each NHVR-aligned walk-around item. All items are required to pass Gate A.
trips.safetyItemsRequired: Tick every item before you can pass the safety check.

safetyItems.wheelsTyresHint: Tread ≥ 1.5 mm, no cuts/bulges, wheel nuts secure
safetyItems.brakesAirHint: Service and parking brakes hold; no air leaks
safetyItems.lightsHint: Headlights, indicators, markers clear; no dash warnings
safetyItems.engineFluidsHint: No leaks; oil and coolant in range
safetyItems.cabinSafetyHint: Windscreen, seatbelts, extinguisher; triangles if GVM > 12t
safetyItems.loadCouplingsHint: Load restrained; couplings engaged and locked
safetyItems.fitForDutyHint: I am fit to drive and have taken required rest under NHVR rules

trips.odometerStartHint: Read the vehicle odometer before you leave. Required for the run sheet.
trips.odometerEndHint: Final reading at the last dropoff. Compared to GPS — a >10% gap flags Super Admin review.
trips.massClearedNotice: Mass check cleared ({{kg}} kg). Gate is clear — proceed to start trip.
trips.phaseAtDropoffBody: Capture receiver signature and goods photos below, then finalize POD.
trips.phasePodDoneLeaveTitle: POD done — leave site to finish trip
trips.phasePodDoneLeaveBody: Tap I’ve left drop-off so geofence can record your exit. The trip completes after all stops are exited and every drop POD is finalized.
trips.leaveDropoffHint: Sends your location outside the drop geofence (or a clear outside ping in cab). Required after POD so the trip can complete.
trips.leaveStopHint: Records geofence exit for the stop you are still on. Needed after POD if an earlier stop was never exited.
trips.leaveDropoffNoDwell: You are not currently recorded as on site. Arrive at the drop first, or update your GPS location.
trips.leaveDropoffFailed: Could not record leaving the site. Try again or check your GPS location.
trips.podFinalizedLeaveHint: POD finalized and confirmation emails sent successfully. Tap I’ve left drop-off to finish the trip.
trips.podFinalizedTripComplete: POD finalized and confirmation emails sent successfully. Trip completed!
trips.breakGuidance: Advisory NHVR rest: {{minutes}} continuous minutes. End break is always allowed.
trips.breakEndEarlyHint: You can end the break early — this timer is guidance only.
trips.notifyApproachingHint: Emails sender + receiver that you are approaching this drop. Use before you arrive at drop-off.
trips.notifyApproachingDoneHint: Approaching email already sent. Next: tap I’ve arrived at drop-off to enter the geofence → then capture POD.
trips.notifyApproachingAtDropHint: Disabled — you are already at/past the dropoff. Notify must be sent before arrival.
trips.notifyApproachingNoDropHint: No DROPOFF stop on this job — notify approaching does not apply.
trips.notifyApproachingNextBody: The notify button stays off on purpose (email already sent). Tap I’ve arrived at drop-off. After status is At dropoff, complete Proof of delivery below.
trips.arriveAtDropoffHint: Closes any unfinished earlier stops (e.g. pickup), then records you at drop-off (device GPS if near, otherwise the drop pin). Status becomes At dropoff — then complete POD below.
trips.arriveAtDropoffDoneHint: Already at drop-off — complete Proof of delivery below.
trips.arriveAtDropoffNoCoords: This drop-off has no map coordinates, so arrival cannot be recorded via geofence.
trips.arriveAtDropoffNoDropHint: No DROPOFF stop on this job.
trips.arriveAtDropoffPriorNoCoords: Earlier stop {{place}} has no map coordinates, so drop-off arrival is blocked. Ask Ops to fix stop coordinates.
trips.arriveAtDropoffStillBlocked: Still recorded on {{stopType}}, not At drop-off. Tap I’ve arrived again (earlier stops are closed first), or use Update GPS / I’ve left on the earlier stop.
trips.arriveAtDropoffFailed: Could not record arrival. Try again or update your GPS location.
trips.msgLocationPingArriving: Location sent. If status is still In transit, an earlier stop may still be open — tap I’ve arrived at drop-off again.
trips.msgLocationAtDropoff: Arrived at dropoff — proof of delivery is ready below.
trips.podHint: Receiver signs on this device. Add at least one goods photo, then finalize.
trips.podAttestPresent: Receiver signed in my presence on this device
trips.podPhotoCompressFailed: Could not process that photo. Try another image.
trips.podPhotoHint: On mobile this opens the camera (or gallery). Photos are compressed before upload.
trips.podBlockedPendingBody: Waiting or other surcharges must be paid or waived before signature, photos, or finalize. Once cleared, complete POD to finish the trip.
trips.podFinalized: POD finalized & confirmation emails sent successfully
trips.podFinalizedSuccessMessage: POD finalized and delivery confirmation emails sent successfully with proof of delivery attached.
trips.reportIssueHint: Use this for sick-call or breakdown. Your carrier and the sender are notified — this is never silent.
trips.reportNotePlaceholder: What happened? Carrier needs enough detail to act.
trips.reportOfflineHint: Reporting unavailable marks you offline for new jobs until your carrier clears you.
trips.reportPhotoRequired: Photo evidence is required for vehicle breakdown.
trips.reportPhotoHint: Take or upload a clear photo of the vehicle issue (JPEG/PNG/WebP).
trips.reportPhotoReady: Photo attached and ready to submit.
trips.reportSuccess: Issue reported. Carrier and sender have been notified.
trips.reportSuccessOffline: Issue reported. You are offline for new assignments. Carrier and sender have been notified.

exceptions.title: Trip exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Sick-call and breakdown reports that need carrier action. Never silent.
exceptions.emptyHint: When a driver reports unavailable or a breakdown, it appears here for reassignment.
exceptions.notifyHint: Opening and resolving exceptions emails the driver, carrier contacts, and sender.
exceptions.reassignHint: Pick an active vehicle and driver. The sender must Approve before the crew is swapped — the trip stays blocked until then.
exceptions.reassignHintVehicle: Vehicle breakdown: choose a different vehicle. Same driver is OK. Sender must approve before the trip resumes.
exceptions.reassignHintDriver: Driver unavailable: choose a different driver. Same vehicle is OK. Sender must approve before the trip resumes.
exceptions.reassignHintAccident: Accident: choose a different vehicle and a different driver. Sender must approve before the trip resumes.
exceptions.reassignHintFlexible: Change the vehicle, the driver, or both. Sender must approve before the trip resumes.
exceptions.reassignSuccess: Replacement proposed. Trip stays blocked until the sender approves.
exceptions.awaitingSenderHint: Do not use Repair & continue for this path. The trip stays in {{tripStatus}} until the sender Approves (crew swap) or Rejects. You can change the proposed crew below.
exceptions.awaitingSenderStatusLine: Exception {{exceptionStatus}} · Trip {{tripStatus}} · Next: sender Approve / Reject
exceptions.resolvePathLabel: How do you want to proceed?
exceptions.resolvePathHint: Choose one path. Only that form is required — the others stay hidden.
exceptions.resolvePathReassignDesc: Propose a new vehicle/driver. Sender must approve before the trip resumes.
exceptions.resolvePathContinueDesc: Same crew after a fix. Clears breakdown and resumes the trip now.
exceptions.resolvePathEscalateDesc: Hand off to Ops when you cannot rescue in-fleet.
exceptions.resolvePathReleaseDesc: Cancel this assignment and re-list the job for other carriers.
exceptions.continueHint: Same crew continues after a fix. Sender and driver are notified with any ETA note.
exceptions.continueSuccess: Exception closed as continued. Parties notified.
exceptions.escalateHint: Use when you cannot rescue in-fleet. Ops and the sender are notified explicitly — never silent.
exceptions.escalateSuccess: Escalated to Ops. Sender and Ops notified.
exceptions.opsSubtitle: Open and escalated exceptions across carriers. Read-only in v1.
exceptions.opsEmptyHint: Escalated and awaiting-carrier exceptions appear here for Ops visibility.
exceptions.opsReadOnly: Read-only — carrier acts in their Exceptions inbox.
exceptions.suggestUnambiguousTitle: Single eligible crew — ready to confirm
exceptions.releaseHint: Cancels the current assignment/trip and re-lists the job on the board with priority and a carrier-facing discount. Sender estimate stays unchanged.
exceptions.releaseSuccess: Job re-listed on marketplace with priority. Parties notified.
exceptions.slaElapsed: SLA elapsed — auto re-list pending or already running
exceptions.slaOpenStatusesOnly: SLA applies while awaiting carrier rescue (pre-trip).

track.title: Live track
track.mapDeferredHint: Map will appear once the trip is live.
